comment: CSS convention RATCHET baselines for check-css-conventions.js: stray media-query widths (canonical: 480/640/900/1200) and raw hex colours outside token definitions. These numbers only ever go DOWN — when a PR removes some, lower the count in the same PR. Never raise one to get green; use a token / a canonical breakpoint instead. Re-baseline after a cleanup with: node check-css-conventions.js --update
